title: xFeviAI
body:
> ### xFeviAI - Minecraft AI Chatbot
> xFeviAI is an advanced AI-powered chatbot mod for Minecraft that brings intelligent conversation directly to your in-game chat. Built by xFevi Studio.

> ## Features
> AI Chatbot: Ask questions about crafting, game mechanics, survival tips, and commands
> Multilingual Support: Automatically detects and responds in the same language as the player
> Quick Commands: Easy enable/disable with simple commands

> ## Commands
> /xFeviAI ON - Enable the AI chatbot
> 
> /xFeviAI OFF - Disable the AI chatbot

> ## DEMO Version
> This is a DEMO version of xFeviAI. The full version with enhanced features and capabilities is showcased in the video by @xfevik on YouTube.

> ### About
> - Created by: xFevi Studio
> - Developer: @xFevik (YouTube)
> - Website: https://xfevi.pl
> - YouTube Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@xFevik

> ## Installation
> 1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.11
> 1. Download the xFeviAI mod file
> 1. Place the mod file in your .minecraft/mods folder
> 1. Launch the game and enjoy!

> ## Requirements
> - Minecraft **1.21.11**
> - Fabric Loader
> - Fabric API

> ## Version
> Current version: **1.1.8**
